Messages.Author: Psi
Messages.Body:
Hi, I am slightly unsure about these ones.

Scenario 1: My vampire has a Fire Dance on them and they play Burst of
Sunlight (basic) as a strike, do they take 1 agg as normal or 1 normal
damage (if this is the agg they want to change).

Scenario 2: My vampire has a Fire Dance, play Dawn Operation when
blocked and Weather Control in the resulting combat, can you use the
Fire dance to change the point of agg to normal from the Weather
Control, like Skin of Night, or not.

Apologies for being a bit of a fool on this point, but it is to resolve
a potential arguement in advance (pretty much over the word "inflicted"
- whether it can be my own vampire or only the opposing vampire).
Thanks,

Joel

Fire Dance [Sabbat:U, Tenth:A]
Cardtype: Action

Requires a ready archbishop, priscus, cardinal <or regent>. +1 stealth
action.
Put this card on a Sabbat vampire. Once each combat, the vampire with
this card may change 1 aggravated damage inflicted on him or her to
normal damage. A vampire may have only one Fire Dance.
